reason: Rulesets and branch protection on main were read via the GitHub API on 2026-10-12. 5 of 7 federation repositories (thehub-pr, aguayluz-pr, ovnis-pr, skywatcher-pr, centinelas-pr) still have nothing protecting main. The two that do, moneysweep-pr and spiderweb-pr, require their own CI checks but none of federation-governance, federation-governance-certify or federation-compatibility, so no federation check is merge-blocking anywhere yet.

branch_protection_audit.method: GitHub REST API: `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rules/branches/main` (rules from every active ruleset) and `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/main/protection/required_status_checks` (classic branch protection)

moneysweep-pr.via: ruleset main-protection (also requires a pull request with 1 approval)

held.aguayluz-pr: refresh.yml commits scheduled data refreshes straight to main with the Actions token; a required check would reject those pushes because docs-sync only runs on pull requests

docs_sync_gate.apply_with: tools/require_docs_sync.py --apply, run by a repository administrator

certification_rule: Do not issue CERTIFIED until required status enforcement is evidenced for main on all seven repositories.
